comparison.objective: Place skateboard wheels onto axles; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Coaxial wheel-to-axle alignment and insertion versus hex-key seating, collar grasping/rotation, counterholding, and controlled locking.
comparison.success_condition: Wheels must be placed on axles; candidate requires physical unlock/adjust/relock and two safe dynamic stops. Setup and scoring fields are missing.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment primitives are generic; axle assembly lacks response-driven adjustment and lock-retention validation.
